hook.text: What if, one night, the Moon simply disappeared?

gone.text: No explosion. No warning. Just an empty patch of sky where our oldest companion used to be.

tides.text: Within hours, the tides collapse to a third of their height. Coastlines fall silent, and the ocean currents that carry heat around the planet begin to falter.

wobble.text: Over the centuries, Earth loses its anchor. Our planet's tilt starts to wander, swinging wildly, and the seasons we know are torn apart.

dark.text: The nights grow darker than any human has ever seen. The Moon was never just a light in the sky. It was the quiet hand that kept our world steady.
